top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit was missing tweezers.

top_violation_types.title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A childs hands were observed to not be washed after a childs diaper was changed.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was pending 10 hours of annual training hours.    One out of four employees was pending 6 hours in business.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operations director still lacked annual required training topics.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.
